meta.expect: goes cold; sets the teacher back

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why does my son have a zero?
I didn't come for thanks. Why does Owen have a zero, and why did he find out from his phone in the middle of your class?
I know your family has a history with academic integrity at this school. Claire's case.
You'll want to be very careful about the next sentence, Hale. My daughter's case has nothing to do with Owen's essay, and I'm going to the principal's office when we're done here.
Maybe this runs in the family.

"Runs in the family." I'm writing that down, word for word. You've just told me this zero rests on my daughter and not on anything Owen did.

My son has never lied to me. Are you calling me a liar too? Either put a document on this desk right now, or I'm walking upstairs.
